Respond  Through: Ms. Kiran Bairwa, APP  CORAM:
 HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE RAVINDER DUDEJA  ORDER % 08.10.2025 CRL.M.A. 29742/2025EXEMPTION Allowed, subject to all just exceptions.
This is a petition for quashing of FIR No. 1325/2020 under Section 498A/406/34 IPC registered at P.S. Sultanpuri as also the proceedings emanating therefrom.
Learned counsel appearing for the petitioner states that both parties have come to an amicable settlement.
However, the complainant is not present today.
Re -notify on 06.02.2026 for recording the settlement.
This is a digitally signed order.
